svg.aria-label: Hosts view of Dependinator: in VS Code the extension host (TypeScript) opens a webview that runs the Blazor WebAssembly UI and starts a self-contained .NET language server that parses the workspace; dependinator.com serves the same WebAssembly UI from Azure Static Web Apps, with a Functions API over Blob Storage for cloud sync; for development a Blazor Server host runs UI and parsers in one process, with a local Functions host and Azurite.
svg.title: Dependinator hosts view
